name: La Era de los Nogales

menus.name: Ambicioso tasting menu
menus.note: Lunch only, for tables seated by 2:30pm; drinks not included; pairings on request, booked at least 48 hours ahead; served at lunch Thursday to Monday (October to April), and at dinner Monday to Wednesday in July and August

menus.name: Coherente tasting menu
menus.note: Lunch only; drinks not included; pairings on request, booked at least 48 hours ahead

bookingOpens: Online through the restaurant's website (TheFork), by email (reservas@laeradelosnogales.com) or by phone. Phone lines are open 10am to 1pm on the days the restaurant opens.
cancellation: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before; after that the restaurant may charge €40 per guest to the card given.
groups: Events and celebrations are arranged through the enquiry form on the events page.
children: No children under 8. A children's menu for ages 8 to 14 costs €35 and must be requested when booking.
